title: Over-broad browser/IDE extension permissions

patterns.message: Extension requests <all_urls> — can read/modify every page (AI-assistant exfil surface).
Extension requests nativeMessaging — can talk to local host processes.
Extension can read the clipboard (credential/secret harvesting surface).
Extension requests the debugger permission (full control of inspected targets).

remediation: Minimize permissions: site/project-scoped host access, no clipboard/nativeMessaging/debugger unless essential; review on each update.
